There is a 7-digit number X in which all the digits are different. Using the digits of X, two 5-digit numbers Y and Z are formed, such that no digit is repeated within Y or within Z. What is the MINIMUM number of digits that Y and Z must have in common?
a) 1
b) 2
c) 3
d) 4
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Bridge
connect to everyday life
Picture 7 different stickers and two cards with 5 empty slots each. Every slot must get a sticker, and no card may repeat one.
Translator
turn words into numbers, pictures or steps
Turn it into numbers: Y and Z together have 5 + 5 slots, but X gives only 7 different digits.
YOUR TURN
How many digits must be used in both numbers?

A 5-digit number has the property that the number formed by its first three digits is the same as the number formed by its last three digits (without changing the order of digits). What is the minimum number of times any digit can appear in this number?
a) 3
b) 1
c) 2
d) 5
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Translator
turn words into numbers, pictures or steps
Draw five boxes: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th. The first three boxes must read the same as the last three.
Roots
ask why it works
Ask why the 3rd box matters: it belongs to both groups. Match place by place: 1st = 3rd, 2nd = 4th, 3rd = 5th.
YOUR TURN
Write the pattern you get. How few times can a digit appear?
